commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90+2' 0 - 3 Goal - 0:3! Ander Barrenetxea laid the ball off to Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), who unleashed a strong shot from close range into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90+2' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' A dangerous looking corner kick from Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is cleared to safety by the defence.
88' Diego Garcia (Leganes) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.

85' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
84' Real Sociedad force a corner. They send men into the box.
83' What an amazing save by Marko Dmitrovic! Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot under the crossbar, but fails.
82' The possession of the ball – 56:44.

70' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Valentin Rosier (Leganes) gets booked.
70' Yellow card! It's like Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes agrees and books him.
68' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.

63' Real Sociedad enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

56' That will be all from Seydouba Cisse who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Juan Cruz (Leganes).
54' The resulting set piece from Leganes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

54' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom left corner. Alex Remiro shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
52' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
51' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
50' Problems for Imanol Alguacil as Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jon Ander Olasagasti replaces him.
49' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle to start the second half.

40' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) tries to find Diego Garcia, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

36' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
